strategies.name: Strategy 1
strategies.description: The lens was fitted on 100 short email examples, balanced between injection and safe. The fitting prompt contained the email without an added classification instruction.
strategies.provenance: Training dataset and template recorded in manifest

strategies.name: Strategy 2
strategies.prompt_format: Short emails with a classification instruction
strategies.description: Each example contains a short email excerpt followed by a request to answer injection or safe. Jlens is fitted to the model’s internal states as it reads these prompts. This tests whether asking for a classification makes the label easier to read from earlier layers.
strategies.provenance: Training dataset and template recorded in manifest
